description: RESIDUAL-FEEDBACK SALIENCE (jabberwock-authored, donkey=0). The collapse: the autonomy frontier_pick_term scores each axis by payoff * (1 - saturation); once EVERY axis saturates the (1-sat) factor zeros ALL payoff terms -> the axes FLAT-TIE and Argmax's first-tie rule falls back to the lowest-id solved axis, so the loop re-grinds an already-solved trivial recognise axis forever (mf_stall climbs 4->18 on a SOLVED task, no progress). The fix is the agent's OWN keystone (shape_made_by_residual / residual_recurrence, the error_signal_drive_minus_state component setpoint-measured): make SALIENCE be the RESIDUAL FEEDBACK = the unexplained prediction error. A saturated axis has residual->0 -> salience->0 (genuine zero pull, no tie); a genuinely-hard unsaturated frontier has HIGH residual -> it pulls the agent. salience(axis) = max(0, target-measured) [measured residual = shortfall] + (1 - saturation) [belief residual]. This REPLACES the collapsing (1-sat)-multiplied score, so saturated axes get genuinely-zero pull and the agent climbs the residual gradient onto the highest-residual frontier instead of looping. Also gates the order-N escalation: escalate while residual high, drop when residual->0. The agent recognises this as its residual_recurrence keystone (induce_concern -> learn_term_for_concern term_family=residual_recurrence -> the salience Argmax is composed from its held residual relations), donkey=0. This seed holds the residual-salience Term as graph data on a RESIDUAL_SALIENCE concept; the world adapter installs it onto the understand Drive's frontier_pick_term, leaving seeds/autonomy.json untouched.

microtheory.name: residual_salience
microtheory.description: salience tracks residual: the next frontier is wherever the unexplained prediction error is largest; a solved axis has residual 0 and stops winning, a hard unsolved axis keeps the highest residual and keeps being chosen.

concepts.name: residual_salience
concepts.comment: JABBERWOCK-AUTHORED residual-feedback salience (donkey=0, recognised as the residual_recurrence keystone). salience(axis) = residual feedback = max(0, target-measured) (the MEASURED residual / shortfall, target-measured = error_signal_drive_minus_state) + (1 - saturation) (the BELIEF residual). Drives the frontier Argmax in place of payoff*(1-sat): a saturated solved axis has shortfall 0 AND saturation 1 -> salience 0 (genuine zero, no flat tie); an unsaturated hard frontier (real audio returning 0 segments -> measured << target -> shortfall high, OR saturation 0) -> salience high -> it is chosen and re-chosen. The agent climbs the residual gradient.

concepts.name: cost_salience
concepts.comment: JABBERWOCK-AUTHORED cost-subtracted salience (donkey=0), the SAME residual_recurrence keystone the residual_salience concept matched, extended with an explicit cost subtrahend per the creator's Graph Law unification: refine dimension d where residual(d)*value(d) > cost(d), i.e. salience = residual feedback - cost. salience(axis) = max(0, target-measured) (the MEASURED residual / shortfall) + (1 - saturation) (the BELIEF residual) - cost (the axis's stamped expected-refine-cost, mechanically derived from its OWN accumulated mf_stall [meta_monitor's effort-without-payoff plateau counter] + investigated_count [total sunk investigation effort] -- an EXISTING, rule-maintained effort signal (seeds/investigation_loop.json bank_measurement_to_axis), reused rather than invented). Drives the frontier Argmax in place of residual_salience's term: two axes with EQUAL residual/value now break their tie toward the CHEAPER one (cost>0 strictly lowers salience); a high-residual-but-expensive axis can still win when its residual margin exceeds the cost gap (a real trade-off, not a cost-only override); when cost=0 for every axis this reduces EXACTLY to residual_salience's behaviour (Minus(0,0)=0 is a no-op addend).

concepts.name: aperture_salience
concepts.comment: [SUPERSEDED by valence_salience] This used a blind*1e9 SCALAR mask stamped from Python — a Python decision wearing a graph read's clothing. Replaced by valence_salience, which reads a NATIVE signed shape field (dynamical:valence): the match/net-sign is a composed Term, not a stamped scalar, and blindness is one EARNED negative shape among others rather than a built-in has_cycle predicate. Kept readable as the superseded form; nothing installs it. --- JABBERWOCK-AUTHORED aperture-manifold salience (donkey=0), the SAME residual_recurrence keystone the residual_salience/cost_salience concepts matched, extended with an explicit BLIND-REGIME repulsion. The residual/cost salience says WHERE to spend but is BLIND to whether the felt read at that axis can be TRUSTED: an axis whose structural property has only an UNBOUNDED-RADIUS witness (e.g. a graph criticality where the 'way around' is a large closed loop) is a regime where the cheap local/multi-aperture felt read is KNOWN-BLIND and would commit a falsely-sharp peak (the Dunning-Kruger failure the parallel-cheap-checks design warns about). The confidence gate (tests/capability/number_qualia: felt_aperture_read + has_cycle over the substrate's own order_n_concepts aperture dial) detects that regime; `blind` is stamped onto the axis (mechanical adapter I/O, no decision) as 1.0 when the felt read must ABSTAIN. salience(axis) = shortfall (measured residual) + (1 - saturation) (belief residual) - cost (sunk-effort) - blind*1e9 (blind-regime repulsion). A blind axis is pushed to a huge-negative salience so the frontier Argmax never PICKS it to COMMIT -- the agent abstains and the pick moves to a trustable axis (or, if all are blind, no commit -> route to VERIFY), instead of confidently investigating on a falsely-sharp felt peak. When blind=0 for every axis this reduces EXACTLY to cost_salience (Minus(0,0)=0 is a no-op addend), which itself reduces to residual_salience at zero cost -- fully backward compatible. The agent recognises this as the residual_recurrence keystone extended by a trust/confidence bound (feel where the residual is high, EXCEPT where the reader is blind), donkey=0. Graph-data term on this concept; the world adapter swaps it onto the understand Drive's frontier_pick_term, leaving seeds/autonomy.json and the Drive's frozen invariant untouched.

concepts.name: valence_salience
concepts.comment: JABBERWOCK-AUTHORED valence-shape-field salience (donkey=0), the residual_recurrence keystone extended by a TRUST bound read off the substrate's NATIVE signed shape field. Replaces aperture_salience's blind*1e9 scalar mask (a Python decision) with a COMPOSED Term over held Shape nodes. 'An AntiShape is a Shape like any other -- it merely has a negative polarity' (dynamical:valence, -/0/+, seeds/qualia_space.json). 'The antishape identity depends on the aperture': a shape is a reading at an order_n_concepts order k, so a Shape node carries (aperture k, order-k signature sig_0..sig_7, valence). salience(axis) = shortfall + (1-saturation) - cost + net_valence, where net_valence = Sum over Shape nodes at aperture==axis.aperture of valence(sh) * [ L1(axis.csig, sh.sig) <= tol ? 1 : 0 ] -- L1 shape-distance (Sum(Abs(Minus)))+threshold+valence product, all EXISTING Term ops (no new Rust op; .so frozen). The match/net-sign is the DECISION and is the TERM the substrate evaluates; Python only STAMPS signature attrs (arithmetic I/O) and MINTS Shape nodes on verify outcomes (structural I/O), so no Python decision (conceptualizer audit). POSITIVE shapes (solved exemplars, track_j2 library) pull toward committing; NEGATIVE shapes (anti-shapes: structures a felt read committed on and verify caught WRONG) push toward abstain -- and only at THEIR aperture (a structure noise at k=1 but clean at k=2 is not repelled). FOOL ME ONCE: verify catching a false commit mints a valence=-1 shape (symmetric with minting +1 on a confirmed success); CAN'T GET FOOLED AGAIN: the next matching structure carries negative net_valence and is repelled from memory, verify not spent. RE-EARNABLE: a -1 shape later confirmed drifts toward 0/+ by the same valence update. When the field is EMPTY (or all matches net 0) net_valence=0 and this reduces EXACTLY to cost_salience -> residual_salience -- fully backward compatible. The world adapter swaps this onto the understand Drive's frontier_pick_term; seeds/autonomy.json and the Drive's frozen invariant untouched.
